newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 19.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Tuesday:
* Benchmark stock index expected to rebound following Wall Street's big rise overnight, brokers say.
* But damages from Typhoon Winnie should dampen sentiment on construction sector, brokers add.
* Amy Huang, analyst, Nomura Securities: "Wall Street's rebound on Monday will give strong momentum to high technology shares."
* Huang: "But I do not expect a huge rise, partly because of caution triggered by the typhoon."
* Philips Taiwan, fully-owned subsidiary of Philips Electronics NV, plans to auction 100 million shares of microchip giant Taiwan Semiconductor 2330. starting Tuesday afternoon.
* Index ended down 64.23 points or 0.66 percent at 9,706.57 on Saturday. Market closed on Monday due to typhoon.
* Trading range for Tuesday seen at 9,650-9,800.
